fact: Table 64 of the 2022 health statistical yearbook reports the completeness of the health centres' monthly reports in 2022 by region and health area: of 2,073 reports expected, 1,747 were entered in DHIS2 (82.2% completeness) and 947 were entered on time (45.7%); the yearbook says its indicators use routine data from the Sistema de Informação de Saúde through DHIS2.
title: Anuário Estatístico da Saúde 2022
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Pública (INASA), Ministério da Saúde Pública, Governo da Guiné-Bissau
